summary: Frontend-only testing of DualList new click-to-move UX in 'Nuovo Report' tab. Logged in as admin, verified: (1) source rows are clickable buttons with ArrowRight and data-testid add-allergen-<code>; (2) clicking a row (e.g., add-allergen-f1) moves it to selected list (selected-allergen-item-f1 appears), row disappears from source, selected-count increments; (3) NO legacy checkboxes (select-allergen-checkbox-*) nor btn-add-selected-allergens present; (4) search 'latte' filters to 6 and clicking filtered row works; (5) category filter badges work (Alimenti -> 124); (6) remove-allergen-<code> restores allergen to source; (7) btn-add-all-allergens moves all 282 visible; (8) btn-clear-all-selected empties; (9) SISS suggested codes panel updates and btn-preview-report-button opens Anteprima Report modal correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New click-to-move UX verified end-to-end; no regressions. DualList.jsx uses <button data-testid=add-allergen-<code>> with ArrowRight icon; footer has btn-add-all-allergens; legacy checkbox testids removed.
